main_text.p: diximus, inquit, ) nulli adstringi locorum intercapedini, ait, prout medium subjectum per universum orbem longe lateque se diffundit: Huc refert energiam Aftrorum, qua haec inferiora luftrant; Solis, qua vifcera terrae; Lunae, qua intima maris pervadit: eadem operationis ratione statuit Aftra fere cuncta caelitus mutationes in corporibus noftris perpetrare; magnetem diffitum quantum vis cynosuram infequi: Quae omnia imprafentiarum lubens praetermitto.

Tertium denique operationis sympathicae modum, qui ex utrisque pendeat, talem exponit, ut pofl certam quandam diftantiam, licet vim & energiam ubique locorum fervet, ex nimia tamen intercapedine vis ejus nonnihil hebefcat. Ejufmodi autem inquit effe inter catera operationem, qua in sympathica vulnerum medicatione continuit. Cum imprejfa enim virtute, inquit, in subjecto aequivoco, diffunditur pariter, ex sanguine vel pure quod effluxit, tenuior

page.notes: Page is in roman type with italic passages; the Latin is partly damaged at the right edge and the transcription of some words (e.g. "imprafentiarum", "cynosuram", "continuit", "aequivoco") is uncertain. The reading of the foot words is partly doubtful; the catchword "tenuiter" is also doubtful.
